name: limit_variable_fillet_on_a_circle
why: The edge of a hole is a circle: closed on itself, with no end and no other. A VARYING radius needs two ends between which to vary, and on a circle there are none. It must be said like this, instead of letting the call fail with «was not created» -- which would send the reader to look for the trouble in the radius.

expect._why_two: the two round edges of the through hole: they are what the case is about to name
